occurrences.title: The Constitution of Knowledge
occurrences.author: Jonathan Rauch
occurrences.imageTitle: The Constitution of Knowledge: A Defense of Truth
occurrences.imageAlt: The Constitution of Knowledge - Jonathan Rauch

quotes.author: Steven Pinker
quotes.text: Vitally important book on truth in our time, The Constitution of Knowledge. Highly recommended

occurrences.description: In this penetrating investigation, Jonathan Rauch looks at how society distinguishes truth from falsehood. He speaks to the "Constitution of Knowledge" and names it a set of norms and institutions which could be an operating system for society: those that guide our collective pursuit of truth. Rauch discusses the kind of system that is based on free speech, open debate, and empirical testing as now under threat in today's digital age. He brings out the key aspect regarding defending and reviving these principles to sustain healthy democracies, where a well-informed public can be made possible. This book is a compelling call to protect the integrity of our truth-seeking endeavors.

occurrences.author: Thomas C. Schelling
occurrences.imageTitle: The Strategy Of Conflict
occurrences.imageAlt: The Strategy Of Conflict - Thomas C. Schelling
occurrences.description: The book is an analytical eye-opener into how conflicts can be resolved using strategic thinking and game theory. The book presents ways through which adversaries may obtain their objectives by predicting each other's decisions within contexts from global politics to personal negotiations. The book brings together insights which discuss the power of commitment, the role of communication in strategy, and what a credible threat really is. Definitely, a seminal text for grasping the conflict-cooperation dynamics.
